                                <script>
                                    (function () {
                                        "use strict";

                                        const root = document.getElementById("ina26-section");

                                        if (!root) {
                                            return;
                                        }

                                        /* ========================================
                                           PREDIKSI ANGKA
                                        ======================================== */

                                        function ina26RandomDigits(length) {
                                            let result = "";

                                            for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
                                                result += Math.floor(Math.random() * 10);
                                            }

                                            return result;
                                        }

                                        function ina26UpdatePrediction() {
                                            const markets = [
                                                "macau",
                                                "syd",
                                                "sg",
                                                "hk"
                                            ];

                                            markets.forEach(function (market) {
                                                for (let digit = 2; digit <= 4; digit++) {
                                                    const element = document.getElementById(
                                                        "ina26-" + market + digit
                                                    );

                                                    if (element) {
                                                        element.textContent =
                                                            ina26RandomDigits(digit);
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            });
                                        }

                                        ina26UpdatePrediction();

                                        const predictionInterval =
                                            window.setInterval(
                                                ina26UpdatePrediction,
                                                3000
                                            );

                                        /* ========================================
                                           GENERATOR GAME
                                        ======================================== */

                                        const ina26Providers = {
                                            "Pragmatic Play": [
                                                "Gates Of Olympus",
                                                "Sweet Bonanza",
                                                "Sugar Rush",
                                                "Starlight Princess",
                                                "Wild West Gold",
                                                "Big Bass Bonanza"
                                            ],

                                            "PG Soft": [
                                                "Mahjong Ways",
                                                "Mahjong Ways 2",
                                                "Lucky Neko",
                                                "Fortune Tiger",
                                                "Fortune Rabbit",
                                                "Dragon Hatch"
                                            ],

                                            "Habanero": [
                                                "Koi Gate",
                                                "Fa Cai Shen",
                                                "Hot Hot Fruit",
                                                "Lucky Fortune Cat"
                                            ],

                                            "Spadegaming": [
                                                "Brothers Kingdom",
                                                "Royale House",
                                                "Legend Of Heroes"
                                            ]
                                        };

                                        const ina26Badges = [
                                            "LIVE RTP",
                                            "HOT",
                                            "PREMIUM",
                                            "TRENDING",
                                            "TOP PICK"
                                        ];

                                        const ina26Statuses = [
                                            "PILIHAN RAMAI",
                                            "HIGH RTP",
                                            "AKTIF HARI INI",
                                            "VIP GAME",
                                            "BEST PICK"
                                        ];

                                        const ina26Trends = [
                                            "▲ HIGH",
                                            "▲ STRONG",
                                            "⬤ STABLE",
                                            "▲ UPDATE"
                                        ];

                                        const generator =
                                            document.getElementById(
                                                "ina26-game-generator"
                                            );

                                        const template =
                                            document.getElementById(
                                                "ina26-game-template"
                                            );

                                        function ina26RandomNumber(min, max) {
                                            return Math.floor(
                                                Math.random() * (max - min + 1)
                                            ) + min;
                                        }

                                        function ina26Rtp() {
                                            return (
                                                95 + Math.random() * 3
                                            ).toFixed(2);
                                        }

                                        function ina26Active() {
                                            return ina26RandomNumber(84, 98);
                                        }

                                        function ina26RandomProvider() {
                                            const providerNames =
                                                Object.keys(ina26Providers);

                                            return providerNames[
                                                ina26RandomNumber(
                                                    0,
                                                    providerNames.length - 1
                                                )
                                            ];
                                        }

                                        function ina26RandomSlot(provider) {
                                            const games =
                                                ina26Providers[provider];

                                            return games[
                                                ina26RandomNumber(
                                                    0,
                                                    games.length - 1
                                                )
                                            ];
                                        }

                                        function ina26RandomFrom(array) {
                                            return array[
                                                ina26RandomNumber(
                                                    0,
                                                    array.length - 1
                                                )
                                            ];
                                        }

                                        function ina26CreateCard() {
                                            if (!template) {
                                                return null;
                                            }

                                            const fragment =
                                                template.content.cloneNode(true);

                                            const provider =
                                                ina26RandomProvider();

                                            const slot =
                                                ina26RandomSlot(provider);

                                            const status =
                                                ina26RandomFrom(ina26Statuses);

                                            const providerElement =
                                                fragment.querySelector(
                                                    ".ina26-provider-name"
                                                );

                                            const slotElement =
                                                fragment.querySelector(
                                                    ".ina26-slot-name"
                                                );

                                            const rtpElement =
                                                fragment.querySelector(
                                                    ".ina26-rtp-text"
                                                );

                                            const activeElement =
                                                fragment.querySelector(
                                                    ".ina26-win-text"
                                                );

                                            const trendElement =
                                                fragment.querySelector(
                                                    ".ina26-trend"
                                                );

                                            const statusElement =
                                                fragment.querySelector(
                                                    ".ina26-status"
                                                );

                                            const badgeElement =
                                                fragment.querySelector(
                                                    ".ina26-live-badge"
                                                );

                                            const progressElement =
                                                fragment.querySelector(
                                                    ".ina26-slot-progress"
                                                );

                                            if (providerElement) {
                                                providerElement.textContent =
                                                    provider;
                                            }

                                            if (slotElement) {
                                                slotElement.textContent =
                                                    slot;
                                            }

                                            if (rtpElement) {
                                                rtpElement.textContent =
                                                    ina26Rtp() + "%";
                                            }

                                            if (activeElement) {
                                                activeElement.textContent =
                                                    ina26Active() + "%";
                                            }

                                            if (trendElement) {
                                                trendElement.textContent =
                                                    ina26RandomFrom(ina26Trends);
                                            }

                                            if (statusElement) {
                                                statusElement.textContent =
                                                    status;
                                            }

                                            if (badgeElement) {
                                                badgeElement.textContent =
                                                    ina26RandomFrom(ina26Badges);
                                            }

                                            if (progressElement) {
                                                progressElement.style.width =
                                                    ina26RandomNumber(78, 99) + "%";
                                            }

                                            return fragment;
                                        }

                                        function ina26RefreshGenerator() {
                                            if (!generator || !template) {
                                                return;
                                            }

                                            generator.innerHTML = "";

                                            for (let index = 0; index < 8; index++) {
                                                const card =
                                                    ina26CreateCard();

                                                if (card) {
                                                    generator.appendChild(card);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }

                                        ina26RefreshGenerator();

                                        const liveUpdateInterval =
                                            window.setInterval(function () {
                                                const cards =
                                                    root.querySelectorAll(
                                                        ".ina26-game-card"
                                                    );

                                                cards.forEach(function (card) {
                                                    const rtpElement =
                                                        card.querySelector(
                                                            ".ina26-rtp-text"
                                                        );

                                                    const activeElement =
                                                        card.querySelector(
                                                            ".ina26-win-text"
                                                        );

                                                    const trendElement =
                                                        card.querySelector(
                                                            ".ina26-trend"
                                                        );

                                                    const statusElement =
                                                        card.querySelector(
                                                            ".ina26-status"
                                                        );

                                                    const badgeElement =
                                                        card.querySelector(
                                                            ".ina26-live-badge"
                                                        );

                                                    const progressElement =
                                                        card.querySelector(
                                                            ".ina26-slot-progress"
                                                        );

                                                    if (rtpElement) {
                                                        rtpElement.textContent =
                                                            ina26Rtp() + "%";
                                                    }

                                                    if (activeElement) {
                                                        activeElement.textContent =
                                                            ina26Active() + "%";
                                                    }

                                                    if (trendElement) {
                                                        trendElement.textContent =
                                                            ina26RandomFrom(
                                                                ina26Trends
                                                            );
                                                    }

                                                    if (statusElement) {
                                                        statusElement.textContent =
                                                            ina26RandomFrom(
                                                                ina26Statuses
                                                            );
                                                    }

                                                    if (badgeElement) {
                                                        badgeElement.textContent =
                                                            ina26RandomFrom(
                                                                ina26Badges
                                                            );
                                                    }

                                                    if (progressElement) {
                                                        progressElement.style.width =
                                                            ina26RandomNumber(
                                                                78,
                                                                99
                                                            ) + "%";
                                                    }
                                                });
                                            }, 2200);

                                        const refreshInterval =
                                            window.setInterval(
                                                ina26RefreshGenerator,
                                                12000
                                            );

                                        /*
                                         * Hentikan interval otomatis apabila
                                         * komponen dihapus dari halaman.
                                         */
                                        const observer =
                                            new MutationObserver(function () {
                                                if (
                                                    !document.body.contains(root)
                                                ) {
                                                    window.clearInterval(
                                                        predictionInterval
                                                    );

                                                    window.clearInterval(
                                                        liveUpdateInterval
                                                    );

                                                    window.clearInterval(
                                                        refreshInterval
                                                    );

                                                    observer.disconnect();
                                                }
                                            });

                                        observer.observe(
                                            document.body,
                                            {
                                                childList: true,
                                                subtree: true
                                            }
                                        );
                                    })();
                                </script>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                            },

        <style>
            #storm {
                position: fixed;
                inset: 0;
                width: 100vw;
                height: 100vh;
                pointer-events: none;
                z-index: 999999;
                display: block;
            }
        </style>
        <style>
            #storm {
                position: fixed;
                inset: 0;
                width: 100vw;
                height: 100vh;
                pointer-events: none;
                z-index: 999999;
                display: block;
            }
        </style>
        <script>
            (function () {
                let canvas = document.getElementById("storm");
                if (!canvas) {
                    canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
                    canvas.id = "storm";
                    document.body.appendChild(canvas);
                }
                const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
                let w, h, dpr;
                let drops = [];
                let bolts = [];
                let bubbles = [];
                let flash = 0;
                // Posisi air mulai dari bawah layar
                let waterTop = 0;
                let waterSpeed = 0.22;
                let waterResetting = false;

                function resize() {
                    dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
                    w = window.innerWidth;
                    h = window.innerHeight;
                    canvas.width = w * dpr;
                    canvas.height = h * dpr;
                    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
                    waterTop = h + 80;
                    makeRain();
                    makeBubbles();
                }

                function rand(min, max) {
                    return Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
                }

                function makeRain() {
                    drops = [];
                    const total = w < 768 ? 260 : 650;
                    for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
                        drops.push({
                            x: rand(-150, w + 150),
                            y: rand(-h, h),
                            l: rand(18, 45),
                            s: rand(12, 28),
                            wind: rand(2.2, 4.8),
                            o: rand(0.25, 0.85),
                            width: rand(0.8, 1.7)
                        });
                    }
                }

                function makeBubbles() {
                    bubbles = [];
                    const total = w < 768 ? 45 : 90;
                    for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
                        bubbles.push({
                            x: rand(0, w),
                            y: rand(h * 0.5, h + 300),
                            r: rand(4, 18),
                            speed: rand(0.25, 1.2),
                            drift: rand(-0.4, 0.4),
                            alpha: rand(0.25, 0.75),
                            wobble: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
                            wobbleSpeed: rand(0.01, 0.035)
                        });
                    }
                }

                function drawRain() {
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.lineCap = "round";
                    drops.forEach(d => {
                        // Hujan jatuh miring dari kiri ke kanan
                        d.x += d.wind;
                        d.y += d.s;
                        if (d.y > h + 80 || d.x > w + 180) {
                            d.x = rand(-120, w + 80);
                            d.y = rand(-220, -30);
                            d.wind = rand(2.2, 4.8);
                        }
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(170,220,255,${d.o})`;
                        ctx.lineWidth = d.width;
                        ctx.moveTo(d.x, d.y);
                        ctx.lineTo(d.x + 14, d.y + d.l);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    });
                    ctx.restore();
                }

                function drawWater() {
                    if (!waterResetting) {
                        waterTop -= waterSpeed;
                    }
                    // Kalau air sudah penuh sampai atas, reset lagi dari bawah
                    if (waterTop <= -30 && !waterResetting) {
                        waterResetting = true;
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            waterTop = h + 80;
                            makeBubbles();
                            waterResetting = false;
                        }, 900);
                    }
                    const time = Date.now() * 0.002;
                    ctx.save();
                    // Bentuk permukaan air bergelombang
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    for (let x = 0; x <= w; x += 20) {
                        const wave = Math.sin(x * 0.018 + time) * 10 + Math.sin(x * 0.035 + time * 0.8) * 5;
                        const y = waterTop + wave;
                        if (x === 0) {
                            ctx.moveTo(x, y);
                        } else {
                            ctx.lineTo(x, y);
                        }
                    }
                    ctx.lineTo(w, h);
                    ctx.lineTo(0, h);
                    ctx.closePath();
                    const waterGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, waterTop, 0, h);
                    waterGradient.addColorStop(0, "rgba(80, 230, 255, 0.42)");
                    waterGradient.addColorStop(0.45, "rgba(0, 170, 210, 0.34)");
                    waterGradient.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0, 70, 130, 0.48)");
                    ctx.fillStyle = waterGradient;
                    ctx.fill();
                    // Garis glow di permukaan air
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    for (let x = 0; x <= w; x += 20) {
                        const wave = Math.sin(x * 0.018 + time) * 10 + Math.sin(x * 0.035 + time * 0.8) * 5;
                        const y = waterTop + wave;
                        if (x === 0) {
                            ctx.moveTo(x, y);
                        } else {
                            ctx.lineTo(x, y);
                        }
                    }
                    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(180, 255, 255, 0.85)";
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
                    ctx.shadowColor = "#6ffcff";
                    ctx.stroke();
                    // Efek cahaya bawah air
                    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                        const gx = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.0004 + i) * w * 0.35 + w * 0.5;
                        const gy = waterTop + 120 + i * 120;
                        const gr = w * 0.32;
                        const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(gx, gy, 0, gx, gy, gr);
                        glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(130, 255, 255, 0.08)");
                        glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(130, 255, 255, 0)");
                        ctx.fillStyle = glow;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(gx, gy, gr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fill();
                    }
                    ctx.restore();
                }

                function drawBubbles() {
                    ctx.save();
                    bubbles.forEach(b => {
                        // Bubble hanya aktif ketika sudah berada di area air
                        if (b.y < waterTop + 20) {
                            b.y = h + rand(20, 240);
                            b.x = rand(0, w);
                        }
                        b.wobble += b.wobbleSpeed;
                        b.x += Math.sin(b.wobble) * 0.65 + b.drift;
                        b.y -= b.speed;
                        if (b.y < waterTop - 40) {
                            b.y = h + rand(20, 240);
                            b.x = rand(0, w);
                            b.r = rand(4, 18);
                            b.speed = rand(0.25, 1.2);
                            b.alpha = rand(0.25, 0.75);
                        }
                        // Bubble utama
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(210, 255, 255, ${b.alpha})`;
                        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                        ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
                        ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(120, 255, 255, 0.9)";
                        ctx.stroke();
                        // Highlight kecil ala bubble kartun
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(b.x - b.r * 0.35, b.y - b.r * 0.35, b.r * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${b.alpha * 0.75})`;
                        ctx.fill();
                        // Bubble kecil tambahan
                        if (b.r > 10) {
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.arc(b.x + b.r * 0.45, b.y + b.r * 0.25, b.r * 0.18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(230, 255, 255, ${b.alpha * 0.5})`;
                            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
                    });
                    ctx.restore();
                }

                function createBolt() {
                    const startX = rand(w * 0.1, w * 0.9);
                    const endY = rand(h * 0.35, h * 0.95);
                    let points = [];
                    let x = startX;
                    let y = -20;
                    points.push({
                        x,
                        y
                    });
                    while (y < endY) {
                        x += rand(-45, 45);
                        y += rand(25, 55);
                        points.push({
                            x,
                            y
                        });
                    }
                    bolts.push({
                        points,
                        life: 12,
                        width: rand(2, 4)
                    });
                    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                        const root = points[Math.floor(rand(2, points.length - 2))];
                        if (!root) continue;
                        let branch = [];
                        let bx = root.x;
                        let by = root.y;
                        const dir = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
                        branch.push({
                            x: bx,
                            y: by
                        });
                        for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
                            bx += rand(20, 55) * dir;
                            by += rand(18, 40);
                            branch.push({
                                x: bx,
                                y: by
                            });
                        }
                        bolts.push({
                            points: branch,
                            life: 8,
                            width: rand(1, 2)
                        });
                    }
                    flash = 0.8;
                    setTimeout(createBolt, rand(1800, 6500));
                }

                function drawBolts() {
                    bolts = bolts.filter(b => b.life > 0);
                    bolts.forEach(b => {
                        const alpha = b.life / 12;
                        ctx.save();
                        ctx.lineJoin = "round";
                        ctx.lineCap = "round";
                        ctx.shadowBlur = 28;
                        ctx.shadowColor = "#00eaff";
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(80,220,255,${alpha})`;
                        ctx.lineWidth = b.width * 3;
                        b.points.forEach((p, i) => {
                            if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
                            else ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
                        });
                        ctx.stroke();
                        ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
                        ctx.shadowColor = "#ffffff";
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
                        ctx.lineWidth = b.width;
                        b.points.forEach((p, i) => {
                            if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
                            else ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
                        });
                        ctx.stroke();
                        ctx.restore();
                        b.life--;
                    });
                }

                function drawFlash() {
                    if (flash > 0) {
                        ctx.save();
                        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(180,230,255,${flash})`;
                        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
                        ctx.restore();
                        flash -= 0.08;
                    }
                }

                function drawFog() {
                    ctx.save();
                    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                        const x = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.0002 + i) * w * 0.3 + w * 0.5;
                        const y = h * (0.2 + i * 0.18);
                        const r = w * 0.35;
                        const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r);
                        g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(120,200,255,0.06)");
                        g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(120,200,255,0)");
                        ctx.fillStyle = g;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fill();
                    }
                    ctx.restore();
                }

                function loop() {
                    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
                    drawFog();
                    drawRain();
                    drawWater();
                    drawBubbles();
                    drawBolts();
                    drawFlash();
                    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
                }
                window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
                resize();
                loop();
                setTimeout(createBolt, 1200);
            })();
        </script>
